justification: The pendant-piece objection ignores the waffle’s additional structure: every hyperplane is an unbounded quasiline ([Remark 3.14](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1904.10482v1.pdf#page=15)). Each component after deleting a vertex contains an incident edge’s dual hyperplane, so every component is unbounded. A cut vertex would therefore imply multiple ends, contradicting quasi-isometry to the one-ended hyperbolic plane. Bounded pendants violate these hypotheses. The assessment does not catch the separate cardinality defect: C₂⊕C₃ has 6 elements, not 12.
